ModMetaData.name: Colony Council: Wishes & Plans
ModMetaData.author: silvanalig
ModMetaData.description:
The colony tells you what it needs. Your colonists tell you what they want. You decide.
[b]Advisor[/b] A "Council" tab that ranks what your colony needs next: food before winter, defences against your growing wealth, bedrooms, heat, medicine, recreation and more. Every point explains why it matters, so you learn the game while you play.
[b]Wishes[/b] Colonists occasionally voice wishes driven by their traits, passions, relationships and mood: "I want my own room", "let me have a proper workshop", "bury my friend", "my partner and I would like to share a bed". Grant them for a mood boost and maybe an inspiration. Kind colonists ask on behalf of others, abrasive ones demand, ascetics turn down luxury. Several colonists wanting the same thing turn into a petition.
[b]Council meetings[/b] About once a season the council meets and three colonists each pitch an ambition: a real hospital, a winter larder, a stronger gate. Pick one, work towards it, and the whole colony celebrates when it's done.
[b]Build help[/b] Room templates with a ghost preview (bedroom, workshop, kitchen, hospital, freezer, dining hall and more). Click a wish or advice item to plan the matching room, or let the council find a spot. Colonists sometimes add personal touches to their own bedrooms.
[b]Fits your world[/b] Everything adapts to your tech level, research, materials and DLCs. A medieval colony gets asked for torches, campfires and spike traps, never turrets or heaters. Works with modded furniture by checking what a building does rather than its name.
Everything is optional and configurable. By default, ignoring a wish costs nothing.
